name: Calamine/zinc oxide (topical)
className: Mild astringent and soothing skin preparation

formulations.label: Lotion
formulations.note: Contains phenol and glycerol as excipients.

src.q: Calamine 15.0% w/v Zinc Oxide 5.0% w/v
Bentonite Sodium Citrate Glycerol Phenol Purified Water

bnf.note: BNF/BNFC is only available in the UK; not accessed.

items.t: Relief of symptoms of mild sunburn and other minor skin conditions.

src.q: For relief of the symptoms of mild sunburn and other minor skin conditions.

restrictions.note: No prescribing restriction stated in the UK SmPC accessed.

items.t: Adults, children and elderly: shake the bottle and apply gently with cotton wool to the affected skin as required.

src.q: The product is suitable for use by adults, children and the elderly.
Apply gently with a pad of cotton wool to the affected parts as required.

items.t: Suitable for children (no lower age limit stated).

src.q: The product is suitable for use by adults, children and the elderly.

items.t: Hypersensitivity to calamine, zinc oxide or any excipient.

src.q: Hypersensitivity to the active substance(s) or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1.

items.t: For external use only. Keep away from children.

src.q: For external use only.
Keep all medicines away from children.

items.t: No drug interactions stated. May mask X-ray images in some circumstances.

src.q: May mask x-ray pictures under certain circumstances.

renal.note: No renal impairment statement in the UK SmPC accessed.

hepatic.note: No hepatic impairment statement in the UK SmPC accessed.

items.t: No safety evidence in pregnancy, but long use without apparent ill effects.

src.q: No evidence has been found as to the safety of the product when used during pregnancy and lactation.
the product has been used for many years without any apparent ill effects

items.t: No safety evidence in breastfeeding, but long use without apparent ill effects.

src.q: No evidence has been found as to the safety of the product when used during pregnancy and lactation.
the product has been used for many years without any apparent ill effects

reproductive.note: No fertility or contraception statement in the UK SmPC accessed.

items.t: Occasional hypersensitivity or irritant reactions (no frequency given).

src.q: Occasional hypersensitivity or irritant reactions.

items.t: If large amounts are swallowed: vomiting, mouth and stomach inflammation, weakness, confusion, cold sweats, weak pulse and leg cramps may occur (contains phenol).

src.q: if large quantities have been ingested, vomiting, inflammation of mucous membranes of the mouth and stomach, weakness, mental confusion, cold sweats, depression of pulse and leg cramps may occur

monitoring.note: No monitoring stated in the UK SmPC accessed.

items.t: Shake the bottle. Apply directly to the skin with a cotton wool pad.

src.q: Shake the bottle.
Apply gently with a pad of cotton wool to the affected parts as required.

items.t: For external use only; do not swallow.

src.q: For external use only.
